expanded_picker_tests.note: Overlaps related suite; adds direct deletion cases.

cause: owned_action and after_dialog guard the application lifetime. The individual wardrobe can finish or be destroyed while that lifetime remains live.
fix: Reject local closed/invalid dialogs at picker entry and before consuming returned directory/color.
scope: Asset picker must not construct installation job after dialog closure.
Color picker must not invoke draft color change after dialog closure.
Reject, reject with deferred destruction, and direct deferred destruction.
limits: Private native Windows desktop and actual widget-local button activation, injected picker return closes/destroys wardrobe. No OS picker interaction claim.
Synthetic layered asset; no full production wardrobe artwork acceptance.
Full regression, independent review and integration pending.
closed_reentry: Both picker entry points reject repeated calls after each of the six closure cases.
excluded_run: native-wardrobe-modal attempted to install identical fixture twice; duplicate version correctly rejected. Corrected fixture setup installs once, then reuses it.
